_comment: State Railway of Thailand night trains, read by scripts/adapters/srt.mjs.

Two official sources, each for what it is good at. The Ministry of Transport's national GTFS (Namtang, namtang-api.otp.go.th, mirrored as Mobility Database mdb-1831) gives station positions, the full stop list of most long-distance trains and the track they run on; its long-distance stop TIMES are placeholders (00:01, 00:02 …) and are never read. SRT's own booking site, D-Ticket (dticket.railway.co.th), gives each train's departure and arrival times and its fare per class and berth, from the same public search a traveller uses before logging in.

A corridor is one D-Ticket search. The adapter keeps a train from a corridor's answer only when it runs overnight (arrives the day after it leaves) and sells a berth, so a day train and a seats-only rapid drop out on their own and a new sleeper on a known corridor is picked up without editing this file. A train found on several corridors (37 is on Bangkok–Hat Yai and Bangkok–Su-ngai Kolok) is filed under the one it rides longest, which is the one ending at its own terminus.

`coordinates` holds a position for a terminus Namtang does not carry (it is a Bangkok-centred feed); `approx: true` marks a position taken from the town's station as published in public references rather than from an SRT feed — replace it with an official one when a feed carries it.

pairs._comment: Return train per outbound train where it is not the next number up (SRT numbers a pair n / n+1).

stationNames._comment: Namtang and D-Ticket spellings → the one name the map uses. Bangkok's terminus is named with its city first, as D-Ticket's own trip list does: few travellers know Krung Thep Aphiwat by name. `origin` stays D-Ticket's station-list spelling, which is what its id is looked up by.

fareClasses._comment: D-Ticket coach class × berth → our class key. Seats are never priced; a coach for women and children only or for passengers with disabilities sells the same berths at the same fare and is left out, as women-only compartments are elsewhere.
